description: arXiv:2603.20990v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hard-negative source selection for dense retrieval is usually decided only after fine-tuning and downstream evaluation. We propose ECIsem, a validity-weighted diagnostic that ranks candidate hard-negative sources using frozen target-encoder embeddings. ECIsem is training-free, not label-free: each scored example requires a query, a label...
